name: Adam Bielan - § 1, après le point d - Am 7
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy on the changing geopolitical situation in East Asia and the need for closer cooperation with like-minded partners in the region
part_text: Ab. whereas reducing strategic dependencies, notably on China, and making supply chains more resilient and more diversified in critical sectors are essential for the EU’s economic security and competitiveness, in line with the EU’s derisking strategy, while avoiding unnecessary economic decoupling;
